text: You think one account covers both needs. But money has two distinct jobs right now. Open your ledger to name the emergency reserve separately from any planned future purchase you intend to make. Check what is already committed and record the clear distinction between safety funds dedicated now versus specific plans for later. Mixing these purposes creates hidden risk when unexpected expenses arrive, leaving your essential buffer exposed to unnecessary depletion. Verify that your current balance meets the reserve requirement before funding any new specific plan or future project. Follow Wealth Blueprint. Build wealth on purpose.
title: The Same Savings Cannot Pay For Two Plans
